name: San Miguel de Allende & Guanajuato
about: High elevation (~1,900m) keeps it mild nearly year-round; the Cervantino Festival, Mexico's biggest international arts festival, runs in Guanajuato every October.
overview: Colonial Bajío highlands an hour apart — San Miguel's pastel streets and art scene, Guanajuato's colorful buildings and underground tunnel roads.
costOverview: Affordable even as their popularity has grown — a full plate of enchiladas mineras costs just a few dollars, and taxis across town rarely run more than a few dollars either.

specialSeasons.text: The Cervantino Festival brings international theater, music and dance to Guanajuato — Mexico's largest arts festival.
